brief.t: START HERE: Open the Optiphen Plus COA with Ron/QC and Sam; confirm the lot and document exception before treating it as cleared.

ACT NOW 1: Optiphen Plus COA exception remains unresolved. Yesterday's Email visual review flagged acid value 5.9 versus 25.0–37.5 and phenol 29.7 ppm versus maximum 6 for batch 0002751898-18586. No newer resolution found. This is a document exception, not proven failed material, receipt or production stoppage. Send internally: Ron and QC, please match the Optiphen Plus COA to our lot and resolve the conflicting results with Sam today before treating it as cleared.

ACT NOW 2: Match the existing seed-oil order to production. Michael and Evelyn's request is 2 days old: 3.2 kg additional sea buckthorn seed oil was requested. NatureInBottle's existing 5 kg order and payment notice are verified; no dispatch or arrival found. Talova49 lists berry/fruit oil, not seed oil. Project/specification/allocation remain unconfirmed. Do not reorder or substitute. Send internally: Evelyn and Michael, please match the existing 5 kg seed-oil order to your project and specification, then confirm the required arrival and production plan today.

ACT NOW 3: Reset Nadia's sample delivery plan. Nadia's Canada window reaches Nov 1 today; her response task is 18 days overdue. No finished-sample QC release or delivery proof found. Mibelle's ingredient shipment is not the finished sample. Confirm her current destination before arranging anything further. Send internally: Michael and Steve, please confirm Oreka's finished-sample status and Nadia's current delivery address today, then give me a realistic dispatch and arrival date.
